J2 62d9 PLAN REVIEW #1 -> BLOCK (1 blocking, 10 advisory).
BLOCKER (G6, impact 0.85): tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_config.py:192 loads adapters/jira/jira_fields.py BY PATH and reads _LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA off the loaded module. Once J2 moves that literal, the attribute is gone -> AttributeError; re-adding a binding to satisfy it would violate the no-shim rule AND re-create the second copy the story exists to delete (failing the single-dict-literal AC). INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION: I had found this same site myself while reading the tree before the review returned, so this is two independent detections of the same real conflict, not a reviewer artifact.
REMEDIATION (5 edits, description 16030 -> 21125 chars):
 (C, the blocker) Declared the test RE-POINTED, not shimmed: it is updated in this same change to load the relocated map module under adapters/jira_family/ by path, assertion (idea<->IDEA parity) preserved verbatim. Framed as an importer update under the plan's existing 'every importer and mock.patch string updated in this change' rule, NOT an exception to no-shim. It also doubles as the by-path load proof since it exercises spec_from_file_location with no package context.
 (A, ADV6 G6 + ADV10 A1) Decided where RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES lives: it does NOT move. It is Cloud's configured VALUE, not shared logic, so it stays defined in adapters/jira/probe.py and Cloud's probe() injects it. This keeps J1's test_probe_resolved_status_names_pinned passing unmodified and is not a shim. Also justified the added parameter against the Rule-of-Three advisory: it is REQUIRED keyword-only with NO Cloud default, precisely so a DC caller cannot silently inherit Cloud workflow names and misclassify a resolved DC issue as PRESENT_FILTERED.
 (B, ADV4 E4) Corrected a load-bearing citation error the reviewer caught and I verified in the code: acli_cli_ops.py:34 imports ONLY _LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA + _sanitize_comment; the STATUS map is not referenced there at all (only acli.py:69-70,143). Rewrote the call-site inventory accurately.
 (F, ADV1 E1 impact 1.0) Added the missing ACs: the by-path load test was described in the Approach but no AC compelled it; added that AC plus one closing the test_config re-point and one pinning RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES' location.
 (D, ADV7 T4) Added an explicit back-out path: single Gerrit change, git revert; the deleted->Done change is send-side/in-memory and never writes the store, so no data migration on revert.
SKIPPED with justification: ADV8/ADV9 (T7/T5e, impact 0.0) want an ADR for the new seam — that is J8 8c35's entire deliverable, so recorded the split in the description (J2 ships the enforced contract, J8 the prose) rather than duplicating it here. ADV5 (P6, impact 0.4) is generic AC-quality with no specific defect.
Review #2 running.
